records.text: The first minute is not the sound of a wife becoming a widow. To echo her friend Chelsea Barney, the first minute is the sound of a wife becoming a black widow.
records.speaker: Kouri Richins Trial Prosecutor

appearances.snippet: Ironically, in this case against Kouri Richins, for which she was ultimately found guilty, the prosecutors played the 9-1-1 call and said explicitly that it didn't sound like a grieving widow. ...
